title: Inventory turnover
bodyMd: A stationery shop reports that inventory turnover increased after it reduced stock. Sales revenue was unchanged. Its accountant notes that a turnover ratio can rise when the inventory denominator falls, even without additional sales. The shop also experienced more occasions when customers could not find a requested item. The accountant recommends tracking availability alongside turnover.
